name: One More Light
source:
The boy who survived, Mikkel, had his life forever changed. One chance encounter spun the web of destiny into something much [i][b]larger[/b][/i] than ever.

[From [url=https://erebuswulfe.itch.io/one-more-light]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
幸存下来的男孩米克尔的生活永远改变了。一次偶然的邂逅将命运之网编织得比以往任何时候都[i][b]更大[/b][/i]。

[来自[url=https://erebuswulfe.itch.io/one-more-light]Itch.io[/url]]
